correction.issue: v1 used the short label switch-distance for spatial distance to a support boundary in micrometres; it did not define temporal distance to a rounded-state change
correction.resolution: retain the spatial support-boundary diagnostic under an explicit name and add the distinct temporal state-change diagnostic below

temporal_state_change_attribution.definition: absolute time from each event to the nearest boundary at which the rounded state changes; recording endpoints are not state changes
temporal_state_change_attribution.interval_rule: left-closed, right-open; pair bin uses the endpoint nearer a state-change boundary
temporal_state_change_attribution.pair_identity_rule: use the original adjacent same-unit pair and require the same original contiguous state segment before categorization; never filter events first
temporal_state_change_attribution.interpretation: temporal proximity to a state change is separate from spatial proximity to the supported/unsupported target-row boundary
